title: fix(desktop): clear connect timer on WebSocket open in gateway probe
claim: Once the probe socket opens, the connect timer must no longer be able to settle the probe; today a socket that opens in the last readyGraceMs of the connect budget is reported as a connect timeout.

evidence.red: On main with only the new test: 'probe resolves ok when the socket opens late in the connect budget and stays open' fails, Expected {ok:true} Received {ok:false, reason:'Timed out after 50ms waiting for the WebSocket to open.'} (1 failed | 18 passed).
evidence.green: With onOpen calling clearTimers(): electron/gateway-ws-probe.test.ts 19/19 pass.
evidence.negative_control: Commenting out only the new clearTimers() line in onOpen makes the new test fail again with the same 'Timed out after 50ms' reason.
evidence.adjacent: vitest --project electron: gateway-ws-probe, connection-config, connection-config-apply, backend-probes, backend-probes-runtime, backend-connection-state = 6 files, 169 passed. tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit clean; eslint and prettier --check clean on both files.
evidence.source: main apps/desktop/electron/gateway-ws-probe.ts onOpen sets opened=true and arms graceTimer without touching connectTimer; check() never consults `opened`. apps/shared/src/json-rpc-gateway.ts cleanup() clears its timer on open (renderer already correct).

upstream_overlap: None found: gh search prs/issues for gateway-ws-probe, probeGatewayWebSocket, connectTimer, 'probe grace window'. #41570 (closed) only lengthened the grace window. #120750/#96346 reworked the keepWaitingWhile path but not onOpen.
notes: Rebuilt on current main using the existing clearTimers() helper instead of the fork's hand-rolled clear (same effect, smaller). Kanban baggage dropped. NOT_TESTED: the keepWaitingWhile hard-cap variant of the same race (covered by the same line, no test); live Test remote against a real gateway. Commit 006ec6d82a.
